Route17_Text_WatchOutForDiscardedItems:
It's a notice.
Watch out for discarded items.
Route17_Text_SameSpeciesGrowDifferentRat:
TRAINER TIPS
All POKéMON are unique.
Even POKéMON of the same species and level grow at different rates.
Route17_Text_PressBToStayInPlace:
TRAINER TIPS
Press the B Button to stay in place while on a slope.
Route17_Text_DontThrowGameThrowBalls:
It's a notice!
Don't throw the game, throw POKé BALLS instead!
